title: Four untuned hyper-parameters: adversarial verification, the combined operating point, and what T=0.4 is worth once the shipped escalation policy sees it
one_line_verdict: ESSENTIALLY NOTHING MOVES THE HEADLINE. Three of the four knobs are worth exactly or approximately zero accuracy; the fourth (the certified veto's binning) is real, survives its own permutation null at 6.5 sigma, and is worth +0.0012 macro-8. Combined with T=0.4 the best arm is 0.6589 at 1.718x -- +0.0022 [-0.0016,+0.0058] vs always-32B-direct, still a TIE, 0.7x the +0.0029 a significant macro delta needs.
convention: MACRO, equal weight per reporting cell, 8 cells at 1/8, Variant B (MMMU excluded), CLEAN disjoint verifier. Bar = always-32B-direct macro 0.656672. Significance bar |delta| ~ 0.0029.

numerics_pinned.OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL_NUM_THREADS: 1 (8 for the F10 rebuild, stated per section)
numerics_pinned.device: CPU only; no torch in the verification path, so no TF32 exposure
numerics_pinned.row_order: frozen canonical order (src/training_methods/genframe_data.py DUMP_ORDER) for the open half; MedEvalKit dump order for the MCQ half
numerics_pinned.ranker: argmax over raw verifier scores, strict > (first-index argmax) -- never rank_avg

N3_published_PMC_veto.what: independent re-implementation of beat32b_more.f8_veto(5,1.645) on the published fold structure arange(n)%5 vs artifacts/pmc_label_noise_audit_2026-07-29.json

N5_F10_open_cells.what: independent re-implementation of the shipped accuracy-max open policy (best-of-8 verifier pick + F10-L2D rejector -> 32B-direct)

N6_item_alignment.what: 32B-direct judge vectors, stored transfer dumps vs the in-session pool build, item by item

S1_KNOB_BY_KNOB_VERIFICATION._how: each knob's headline was re-derived from the raw dumps by code written for this pass, not by re-running the round's own scripts, except where the round's script IS the object under test.

knob1_hole17_macro_refit.claim: refitting tau/lambda/the open escalation threshold against a MACRO objective is worth +0.0009 macro on the compute-lean arm, p=0.375 against its own permutation null, and EXACTLY 0.0000 on the shipped accuracy-max arm.
knob1_hole17_macro_refit.verification: CONFIRMED as a NEGATIVE. The round's own nested permutation null (200 replicates, macro_iso_cost anchor) gives real +0.0009162 vs null mean +0.0007302 sd 0.0009434, p(null>=real)=0.375; best-of-4-anchors p=0.425. THE GAIN IS THE NULL MEAN. Fold-seed stability over 10 seeds: mean +0.00013, sd 0.00233, range [-0.00325,+0.00348] -- the sign is not stable. Ceiling of the whole threshold family 0.6471 at mu=0, BELOW the 0.656672 bar.
knob1_hole17_macro_refit.contribution_to_the_combined_point_COST: 7.951 -> 7.660 macro FLOP-eq on accuracy-max (1.7398x -> 1.6762x) with accuracy exactly unchanged -- BUT this saving is bought by lowering the Pandora meanN while the accuracy vector still comes from a FIXED best-of-8 pick, i.e. it spends the accounting inconsistency the same round flags as its own side finding (method_final_mmmu_corrected.py:160 charges cost_pandora(meanN) against an argmax(scores[:8]) accuracy). Under the round's recommended repair (ii) it costs -0.0001 judge / -0.0009 EM macro. NOT TAKEN into the combined point.
knob1_hole17_macro_refit.verdict: NO GAIN. Close as diagnosed. The premise ('the thresholds are cross-fit against a POOLED objective') is refuted by the code: paper_baselines.cascade_persample:88 and pandora_persample:120 fit each threshold against THAT CELL's own train target.

knob2_certified_veto_binning.claim: a coarser binning (n_bins 2-4, alpha_z ~0.25) chosen by nested CV under an inner McNemar guardrail (rule R4) is worth +0.00094 macro-8 over the shipped arm at 1.7198x vs 1.7403x.

independent_replication._how: fresh nested-CV implementation, outer 5 x inner 5, 10 fold seeds, own Wilson LB, own binning; shares only the raw MedEvalKit dumps with the round's code
independent_replication.agreement: same sign, same order, mine is +0.00025 larger. The difference is the MedXpert guardrail leak: the round's folds admitted MedXpert on 6% of decisions (-0.00095 on that cell); mine admitted it on 0 of 50 fold decisions. That leak is fold-assignment noise, not a property of the rule.
independent_replication.mechanism_confirmed: COARSER, not looser. The selected settings cluster at n_bins 2-4 with alpha_z in [0,0.5]. More bins => smaller bins => wider Wilson intervals plus the 30-item train guard => nothing certifies, which is exactly why 4 of 5 MCQ cells sit at veto rate 0.0000 under the shipped n_bins=5.

knob2_certified_veto_binning.verdict: REAL and REPLICATED, and it works by switching SLAKE-closed ON for the first time (veto rate 0.0000 -> 0.298). But see S3: its PMC half is answer-prior and its SLAKE half does not cleanly pass the same control.

knob3_verifier_inference_resolution.claim: max_pixels 501,760 is the cheapest rung indistinguishable from the deployed 1,003,520 (d_sel_eff judge exactly 0.000000); the pre-registered prize (scoring at the generator's cap320) is REFUTED at -0.0177 judge / -0.0142 EM.
knob3_verifier_inference_resolution.verification: CONFIRMED as a COST-ONLY result. The round's own leakage control is decisive against any accuracy claim: 'pick the best rung' earns null mean +0.004319 in sample (p95 +0.010899) from SHUFFLED LABELS ALONE, while the real in-sample best rung gains EXACTLY 0.000000 => p = 1.0; nested CV is WORSE than the control (global -0.002044, p=0.6385; per-cell -0.005450, p=0.845). NO RUNG BEATS THE DEPLOYED ONE.
knob3_verifier_inference_resolution.contribution_to_the_combined_point_COST: -6.39% of OPEN-ARM FLOP-eq, -0.52 GiB, -23% batch-1 verifier latency; 1.0003x at the honest macro, i.e. NOTHING. As-charged (the currency this file's frontier uses) it is exactly 0, because pandora_controller.py:50-52 charges one verifier forward at 1.0 regardless of resolution.
knob3_verifier_inference_resolution.verdict: SHIP AS HYGIENE, NOT AS A RESULT.

knob4_weitzman_lambda.claim: refitting lambda on T=0.4 pools LOSES -0.00361 [-0.00553,-0.00172] judge / -0.00399 EM on the open-3 macro (permutation p=0.005); the free win is the TEMPERATURE, not the refit.
knob4_weitzman_lambda.verification: CONFIRMED. The round's five null tests reproduce (frozen metric 3.60e-07, identity 5.55e-17, zeta closed form 3.44e-15, policy bit-exact 0.0, shipped open cells 4.81e-05). Re-read from the ARMS block: A_deployed_T07r open-3 judge 0.579712, B_stale_on_T04 0.588334 (+0.008622), C_refit_T04 0.584719 (-0.003615 vs stale). Both currencies agree.
knob4_weitzman_lambda.verdict: DO NOT REFIT. The incumbent lambda is the better one.

S2_WHAT_T04_IS_ACTUALLY_WORTH_ON_THE_SHI._the_new_measurement: the temperature ladder measured T=0.4 on the SELECTED endpoint (the best-of-8 verifier pick, BEFORE escalation) and knob 4 measured it on the plain-Weitzman open arm. Neither is the shipped accuracy-max open policy, which is best-of-8 + the F10-L2D rejector escalating to 32B-direct. This section measures it there for the first time, with an IN-SESSION T=0.7 control (T07r) generated in the same session as the T=0.4 pools, so the +-0.008 stored-vs-in-session nuisance cancels.
S2_WHAT_T04_IS_ACTUALLY_WORTH_ON_THE_SHI._protocol: 3 generation seeds per temperature, per-item vectors seed-averaged, F10 rejector refit per fold on each pool's own features (identical code both sides), paired item bootstrap nboot=10000 seed 20260815, BOTH currencies on IDENTICAL picks.
S2_WHAT_T04_IS_ACTUALLY_WORTH_ON_THE_SHI.finding: THE SHIPPED ARM'S OWN ESCALATION POLICY ABSORBS THE TEMPERATURE WIN. On the SELECTED endpoint T=0.4 is +0.0083 / +0.0400 / +0.0058 judge per cell (reproducing decoding_ladder_cold_2026-08-14.json exactly). After the F10 rejector, which escalates 55-86% of items to the 32B, the same three cells move +0.0047 / -0.0067 / +0.0033, and the open-3 macro moves +0.00044 [-0.00354,+0.00412] -- a TIE. Only 2.4% of the macro-3 SELECTED gain survives. Under normalised exact match it survives better (+0.00600 [+0.00189,+0.01026], a WIN), so the two currencies DISAGREE about whether T=0.4 helps the shipped arm at all, and the published macro is denominated in the JUDGE.
S2_WHAT_T04_IS_ACTUALLY_WORTH_ON_THE_SHI.why: escalated items take the 32B's answer, which is identical at both temperatures; the temperature can only act on the retained fraction, and F10 preferentially retains the items the 7B already gets right -- exactly the items the temperature cannot improve.
S2_WHAT_T04_IS_ACTUALLY_WORTH_ON_THE_SHI.instability_flag: F10's escalation rate on PATH_VQA_open spans 0.326-0.762 across three generation seeds at the SAME temperature (T07r s0/s1/s2 = 0.406/0.326/0.762). The escalation rate of the shipped open policy is NOT IDENTIFIED at this pool size; no cost claim is made from its movement.

S3_ANSWER_PRIOR_CONTROL._why: the certified veto's PMC gain is 44% attributable to test_2.csv's answer-letter skew (artifacts/pmcvqa_answer_bias_audit_2026-08-11.json). Any cell the TUNED veto newly switches on must clear the same bar, and the tuning must not make the PMC prior worse.

PMC_VQA_independently_recomputed.finding: CONFIRMED. Tuning RAISES the raw PMC delta (+0.00962 -> +0.01051) while LOWERING the letter-balanced one (+0.00536 -> +0.00472) and nearly DOUBLING the gold-A damage (-0.01185 -> -0.02166). The PMC half of the tuning gain is answer-prior.

SLAKE_closed_counter_control_IS_NOT_ROBU._what: the round reports SLAKE-closed's gain GROWING when balanced over gold-answer strata (+0.00778 raw -> +0.01792), and concludes item-level competence rather than an answer prior. That conclusion depends on the arbitrary min-stratum-n threshold.
SLAKE_closed_counter_control_IS_NOT_ROBU.finding: THE COUNTER-CONTROL IS THRESHOLD-DEPENDENT AND THEREFORE INCONCLUSIVE. It is a WIN under the round's n>=30 cut (76.6% of items) and under an AFF/NEG semantic collapse (85% of items), and a TIE with a negative point estimate when all 48 gold-answer strata get equal weight. The gain is concentrated entirely on affirmative answers (+0.0269) while negative (-0.0022) and open-vocabulary (-0.0104) strata go the other way -- which is the shape an answer prior has. The round's sentence 'so it is item-level competence, not an answer prior' should be SOFTENED to 'the control does not settle it'.

S4_PERMUTATION_NULLS._design: the paired labels (ok7, ok32) are permuted JOINTLY within each MCQ cell -- 7B confidence, fold structure, both accuracy marginals and the ok7/ok32 correlation all preserved; only the item-level confidence->outcome link destroyed -- and the ENTIRE nested-CV selection pipeline is re-run. Statistic = the MCQ-side contribution to the 8-cell macro (which IS the whole macro delta, because this knob leaves the open half byte-identical).
S4_PERMUTATION_NULLS._why_mandatory: this project has measured a per-cell 'pick the best' rule earning +0.0109 macro from SHUFFLED LABELS ALONE against +0.0090 on real data (p=0.67).

INDEPENDENT_RUN_this_pass._seeds: RNG stream 900000+rep, 2 fold seeds averaged per replicate, fresh implementation

S4_PERMUTATION_NULLS.reading: THE VETO TUNING IS NOT INSIDE ITS NULL. Unlike the project's prior +0.0109-from-shuffled-labels precedent, these nulls are NEGATIVE: vetoing at random replaces a 32B answer with a worse 7B one, so noise-driven certification LOSES. The guardrail is what keeps the null tight (the round measures the unguarded rule's null sd at 0.00057 against the guarded rule's 0.00020, a 2.9x reduction).

knob1_null.reading: INSIDE THE NULL. The observed effect IS the null mean.

knob3_null.design: labels shuffled within each item's 8-slot pool, 2000 permutations
knob3_null.reading: THE SELECTION PROCEDURE EARNS STRICTLY LESS THAN CHANCE. No 'best rung' claim is licensed.

knob4_null.design: the whole label bundle permuted across items within each cell, 200 replicates
knob4_null.S1_WARNING: shuffled labels REACH the always-32B-direct bar in 90.5% (T=0.4) and 100% (T=0.7) of replicates at a median 4.57 FLOP-eq, because a flat isotonic map makes the controller degenerate into always-32B-direct. 'The controller reaches parity at some compute' is therefore NOT A CLAIM.
knob4_null.reading: the refit-vs-stale contrast and the temperature contrast both SURVIVE; the parity claim does not.

S4_PERMUTATION_NULLS.T04_selection: the temperature was chosen in a PRE-REGISTERED round (artifacts/_decoding_ladder_cold_prereg.json, written before any rung existed) against a matched in-session control, CI-clean in BOTH currencies, with a declared plateau {T03r, T04}. No selection is priced here. What this pass adds is that the SHIPPED ARM does not receive most of that win (S2).

_arms.shipped_accuracy_max: the shipped headline arm (F8 veto on PMC, always-32B-direct on the other 4 MCQ cells, pandora-N + F10-L2D on the 3 open cells)
_arms.shipped_best_cost_point: the pre-specified per-cell arm swap of cost_decomposition_2026-08-12.json: certified veto on PMC, compute-lean on SLAKE-closed and PathVQA-closed, always-32B-direct on VQA-RAD-closed, MedXpert AND all three open cells
_arms.A_veto_tuned_accuracy_max: shipped accuracy-max with the R4 tuned veto (knob 2) on the MCQ half
_arms.B_T04_accuracy_max: shipped accuracy-max with the open half regenerated at T=0.4 (knob 4's free lever)
_arms.D_COMBINED_cost_point: the shipped best cost point with the R4 tuned veto substituted on the two cells R4's own inner guardrail admits (PMC, SLAKE-closed). T=0.4 does nothing here because all three open cells already run always-32B-direct.

S5_THE_COMBINED_OPERATING_POINT._cost_currency: as-charged FLOP-eq, equal weight per cell, from _selector_rerun_parts/macro_disjoint.json; veto cell = 1.0 + (1-v)*4.57; a fold whose certificate accepts no bin never runs the 7B and costs 4.57.
S5_THE_COMBINED_OPERATING_POINT._note_on_the_open_half: arms B and C apply the IN-SESSION-MATCHED T04-minus-T07r per-item delta to the stored open vectors, so the stored-vs-in-session nuisance cancels in the delta but the arm's absolute open cells remain the stored ones. Their open cost is held at the shipped values: knob 4 measures meanN essentially unchanged under the stale policy at T=0.4 (5.919 -> 5.934), and the escalation-rate moves are inside generation-seed noise (S2 instability flag).

ADDITIVITY.reading: EXACTLY ADDITIVE ON THE 8-CELL MACRO, by construction: knob 2 moves only multiple-choice cells and T=0.4 moves only open cells, and the macro is an equal-weight average over disjoint cells. THE SUB-ADDITIVITY IS INSIDE THE OPEN HALF, not between the knobs: T=0.4 is worth +0.0180 on the open-3 SELECTED macro and +0.00044 after the shipped arm's own F10 escalation, i.e. 2.4% survives (S2). Knob 1 and knob 3 are exactly 0.0000 on accuracy, so there is nothing for them to be sub-additive with.

D_arm_scrutiny._why: D is the only CI-clean win in this pass, and it has the shape the project has already learned to distrust (armcombine_mcqonly_2026-08-11.json: 'a CI-clean macro WIN that works by switching the method OFF').

leave_one_cell_out_of_the_vs_direct_delt.reading: unlike armcombine_mcqonly (which goes to exactly 0.000 on dropping PMC), D survives every leave-one-out at >= +0.0011. Two cells carry it, not one.

answer_prior_corrected.reading: THE VERDICT FLIPS WITH AN ARBITRARY STRATUM THRESHOLD. Under the answer-prior-corrected currency D's macro delta is anywhere from +0.0001 to +0.0030 depending on a choice with no canonical answer. That is not a shippable win.

D_arm_scrutiny.selection_status: POST-HOC / EXPLORATORY. The cost point's cell assignment is pre-specified (cost_floor_2026-08-10 cross-fit) and the veto setting comes from R4's nested CV under its own permutation null, but the DECISION TO COMBINE THEM was taken after seeing both results. It needs pre-registration before it can be claimed.
D_arm_scrutiny.guardrail: clean on all 8 cells against always-7B AND against always-32B-direct.

S6_HEADLINE_TRANSLATION.does_anything_move_the_headline: NO. The published headline is '+0.0615 [+0.0514,+0.0715] vs a reasoning 32B, TIE vs always-32B-direct, at 1.74x'. After this round the best defensible accuracy-max point is 0.6589 at 1.718x: the vs-reasoning claim is unchanged (the reasoning baseline is untouched), and the vs-direct verdict is still a TIE (+0.0022 [-0.0016,+0.0058], 0.76x the +0.0029 bar).
S6_HEADLINE_TRANSLATION.the_only_Pareto_statement_available: D dominates the shipped accuracy-max arm on BOTH axes (0.65895 vs 0.65750 at 0.915x vs 1.740x) -- but it does so by running always-32B-direct on all three open cells, i.e. by switching the open-text machinery off, and its accuracy edge is answer-prior-sensitive (S5). It does NOT dominate the best cost point, which is 5.8% cheaper.
S6_HEADLINE_TRANSLATION.what_the_bar_needs: a summed per-cell gain of ~+0.0235. The whole of this round delivers +0.0182 summed (D) or +0.0109 summed (C), of which the answer-prior-corrected part is +0.0009 to +0.0242.

S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.item: An answer-letter-bias audit of PMC-VQA test_2.csv
S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.why: it was already OWED (armcombine_mcqonly_2026-08-11) and this round makes it load-bearing twice over: the veto tuning's PMC gain moves the RAW delta up (+0.00962 -> +0.01051) and the letter-balanced delta DOWN (+0.00536 -> +0.00472), and every arm in the frontier table above carries PMC as its largest single cell.

S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.item: A canonical definition of the answer-balanced currency for open-vocabulary closed cells
S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.why: SLAKE-closed's counter-control swings from -0.00293 to +0.02041 across min-stratum-n in {1,...,30} (S3). Whether knob 2's newly-switched-on cell is competence or prior is currently a choice, not a measurement.

S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.item: Pre-register arm D and re-run it on a held-out draw
S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.why: it is the only CI-clean point in the round and it was assembled post hoc.

S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.item: Fix the accuracy/cost inconsistency at method_final_mmmu_corrected.py:160 (repair (ii))
S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.why: the accuracy-max open cells charge cost_pandora(meanN, esc) with meanN 4.37-6.63 while the accuracy comes from argmax(scores[:8]). Every cost claim on the accuracy-max arm -- including knob 1's 1.740x -> 1.676x -- currently spends that inconsistency. Repair (ii) costs -0.0001 judge / -0.0009 EM macro and preserves the published 1.740x.

S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.item: The pre-registration candidate the veto sweep found and could not claim: n_bins=12 with alpha_z in {1.96, 2.326}
S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.why: the only 2 of 135 settings that beat the shipped one LETTER-BALANCED (+0.00623 / +0.00569 vs +0.00534), and they move the OPPOSITE way from what the sweep selects (tighter bound, lower veto rate 0.333 vs 0.400). Found by ranking the eval set in a currency chosen after the fact => pre-registration candidate only.

S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.item: An identified escalation rate for the F10 open policy
S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.why: F10's escalation rate on PATH_VQA_open spans 0.326-0.762 across three generation seeds at the SAME temperature. No open-half cost claim is safe until that is pinned.

S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.item: Retire the Weitzman controller in favour of a cross-fit fixed N=1 + confidence gate
S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.why: knob 4's addendum measures it more accurate in both currencies, 2.7x cheaper and 3.3x faster sequentially than the refitted controller. It would remove the adaptive-N machinery the surviving '11.74 vs 16.0 FLOP-eq (-27%)' claim depends on, so that claim must be re-examined at the same time.

S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.item: Ship max_pixels 501,760 for the verifier as cost hygiene
S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.why: -6.39% open-arm FLOP-eq, -0.52 GiB, -23% batch-1 verifier latency at d_sel_eff judge exactly 0.000000. Zero at the macro. No accuracy claim attaches.

S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.item: NOT WORTH DOING: any further sweep of tau, lambda or the open escalation threshold
S7_WHAT_IS_LEFT_ranked.why: knob 1 measured the ceiling of that whole threshold family at macro 0.6471 (mu=0, pure accuracy maximisation), BELOW the 0.656672 bar. No re-scalarisation can reach it.

S8_CAVEATS_OF_RECORD: Nothing ran end to end. Every operating point is a CPU re-costing of saved per-sample dumps with measured batch-1 constants. VRAM is not measured in this pass.

Arms B and C mix STORED open cells with an IN-SESSION-MEASURED delta; the delta is nuisance-cancelled but the absolute open cells are the stored ones. Arms A and D touch only the MCQ half and are free of that mix.
The 8-cell macro's open cells are denominated in the 32B JUDGE. Every open-half number in this file is reported in BOTH currencies, and S2 is the case where they disagree about the verdict.

vqa_rad cells are n=200/251. VQA_RAD_open is guardrail-FLAGGED against always-32B-direct in arms B and C (-0.01667 with the T04 substitution vs -0.01000 shipped), and that move is inside generation-seed noise.

MedXpertQA-MM is guardrail-flagged at -0.00095 [-0.00185,-0.00010] in the ROUND's R4 (6% of folds admit it) and at exactly 0.0000 in this pass's independent replication (0 of 50 fold decisions admit it). The leak is fold-assignment noise; the rule should carry an explicit never-deploy-on-MedXpert clause if it is ever shipped.

Two A100s were shared with concurrent sessions throughout. No GPU job was launched in this pass -- it is CPU numpy over stored caches -- and nothing was killed. MedEvalKit/ untouched. freeze_selector.py NOT run. No visual LoRA scored under vLLM.
